# Kamayega Bharat - Local Employment & Talent Marketplace
**Developer:** Sourav Bagchi

> A high-performance, dual-sided job platform built to connect local talent with verified employers in India, featuring real-time data synchronization and professional verification.

Kamayega Bharat is an advanced recruitment ecosystem developed to bridge the gap between job seekers and employers. The platform utilizes Firebase for real-time messaging and status updates, ensuring a seamless experience for users in Jharkhand and across Bharat. It features a unique verification system for companies to establish trust.

## Core Pages
- [Home Page](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/index.html): Entry point with role redirection.
- [Authentication](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/login.html): Secure login and registration for Seekers and Employers.

## Seeker Features
- [Job Dashboard](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html): Search and filter verified "Golden Frame" jobs.
- [Portfolio Manager](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html): Centralized skill and document management.
- [Live Messaging](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html): Real-time chat with prospective employers.

## Employer Features
- [Employer Dashboard](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/employer.html): Job posting and application management.
- [Worker Database](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/employer.html): Talent search filtered by specific technical skills.
- [Company Verification](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/employer.html): Process for obtaining professional verification status.

## Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/terms.html): Usage guidelines for the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/privacy.html): Data protection and privacy standards.

## Project Mission
To empower the Indian workforce by providing a fast, secure, and transparent bridge between skill and opportunity.
